messages.CeruleanCityRivalPreBattleText: {RIVAL}: Yo! {PLAYER}!You're still struggling along back here?I'm doing great! I caught a bunch of strong and smart POKEMON!Here, let me see what you caught, {PLAYER}!
messages.CeruleanCityRivalDefeatedText: Hey! Take it easy! You won already!
messages.CeruleanCityRivalVictoryText: Heh! You're no match for my genius!
messages.CeruleanCityRivalIWentToBillsText: {RIVAL}: Hey, guess what?I went to BILL's and got him to show me his rare POKEMON!That added a lot of pages to my POKEDEX!After all, BILL's world famous as a POKEMANIAC!He invented the POKEMON Storage System on PC!Since you're using his system, go thank him!Well, I better get rolling! Smell ya later!
messages.CeruleanCityRocketText: Hey! Stay out! It's not your yard! Huh? Me?I'm an innocent bystander! Don't you believe me?
messages.CeruleanCityRocketTM28NoRoomText: Make room for this!I can't run until I give it to you!
messages.CeruleanCityRocketIGiveUpText: Stop! I give up! I'll leave quietly!
messages.CeruleanCityRocketIllReturnTheTMText: OK! I'll return the TM I stole!
messages.CeruleanCityCooltrainerMText: You're a trainer too? Collecting, fighting, it's a tough life.
messages.CeruleanCitySuperNerd1Text: That bush in front of the shop is in the way.There might be a way around.
messages.CeruleanCitySuperNerd2Text: You're making an encyclopedia on POKEMON? That sounds amusing.
messages.CeruleanCityGuardText: These poor people here were robbed.We're positive that TEAM ROCKET is behind this terrible deed.Even our POLICE FORCE has trouble with the ROCKETs!
messages.CeruleanCityCooltrainerF1ElectrodeUseSon: OK! ELECTRODE! Use SONICBOOM! Please ELECTRODE, pay attention!
messages.CeruleanCityCooltrainerF1ElectrodePunchT: ELECTRODE, TACKLE! No! You blew it again!
messages.CeruleanCityCooltrainerF1ElectrodeWithdr: ELECTRODE, SWIFT! No! That's wrong!Training POKEMON is difficult!Your POKEMON's obedience depends on your abilities as a trainer!
messages.CeruleanCityCooltrainerF2Text: I want a bright red BICYCLE!I'll keep it at home, so it won't get dirty!
messages.CeruleanCitySuperNerd3Text: This is CERULEAN CAVE! Horribly strong POKEMON live in there!The POKEMON LEAGUE champion is the only person who is allowed in!
messages.CeruleanCitySignText: CERULEAN CITY A Mysterious, Blue Aura Surrounds It
messages.CeruleanCityTrainerTipsText: TRAINER TIPSPressing B Button during evolution cancels the whole process.
messages.CeruleanCityBikeShopSign: Grass and caves handled easily! BIKE SHOP
messages.CeruleanCityGymSign: CERULEAN CITY POKEMON GYM LEADER: MISTYThe Tomboyish Mermaid!
messages.CeruleanGymMistyPreBattleText: Hi, you're a new face!What's your policy on POKEMON? What is your approach?My policy is an all-out offensive with water-type POKEMON!MISTY, the world- famous beauty, is your host!Are you ready, sweetie?
messages.CeruleanGymMistyTM11ExplanationText: TM11 teaches BUBBLEBEAM!Use it on an aquatic POKEMON!
messages.CeruleanGymMistyCascadeBadgeInfoText: The CASCADEBADGE makes all POKEMON up to L30 obey!That includes even outsiders!There's more, you can now use CUT anytime!You can CUT down small bushes to open new paths!You can also have my favorite TM!
messages.CeruleanGymMistyTM11NoRoomText: You better make room for this!
messages.CeruleanGymMistyReceivedCascadeBadgeText: I can't believe I lost!All right!You can have the CASCADEBADGE to show you beat me!
messages.CeruleanGymBattleText1: I'm more than good enough for you!MISTY can wait!
messages.CeruleanGymAfterBattleText1: You have to face other trainers to find out how good you really are.
messages.CeruleanGymBattleText2: Splash!I'm first up! Let's do it!
messages.CeruleanGymAfterBattleText2: MISTY is going to keep improving!She won't lose to someone like you!
messages.CeruleanGymGymGuideChampInMakingText: Yo! Champ in making!Here's my advice!The LEADER, MISTY, is a pro who uses water POKEMON!You can drain all their water with plant POKEMON!Or, zap them with electricity!
messages.CeruleanGymGymGuideBeatMistyText: You beat MISTY! What'd I tell ya?You and me, kid, we make a pretty darn good team!
messages.CeruleanMartCooltrainerMText: Use REPEL to keep bugs and weak POKEMON away.Put your strongest POKEMON at the top of the list for best results!
messages.CeruleanMartCooltrainerFText: Have you seen any RARE CANDY?It's supposed to make POKEMON go up one level!
messages.CeruleanPokecenterSuperNerdText: That BILL!I heard that he'll do whatever it takes to get rare POKEMON!
messages.CeruleanPokecenterGentlemanText: Have you heard about BILL?Everyone calls him a POKEMANIAC!I think people are just jealous of BILL, though.Who wouldn't want to boast about their POKEMON?
messages.MelanieText1: I take care of injured POKEMON.I nursed this BULBASAUR back to health.It needs a good trainer to take care of it now.
messages.MelanieText2: I know! Would you take care of this BULBASAUR?
messages.CeruleanTrashedHouseFishingGuruTheyStole: Those miserable ROCKETs!Look what they did here!They stole a TM for teaching POKEMON how to DIG holes!That cost me a bundle, it did!
messages.CeruleanTrashedHouseFishingGuruWhatsLost: I figure what's lost is lost!I decided to teach DIGLETT how to DIG without a TM!
messages.CeruleanTrashedHouseGirlText: TEAM ROCKET must be trying to DIG their way into no good!
messages.CeruleanTrashedHouseWallHoleText: TEAM ROCKET left a way out!
messages.CeruleanBadgeHouseMiddleAgedManText: POKEMON BADGEs are owned only by skilled trainers.I see you have at least one.Those BADGEs have amazing secrets!
messages.CeruleanBadgeHouseMiddleAgedManWhichBadg: Now then...Which of the 8 BADGEs should I describe?
messages.CeruleanBadgeHouseMiddleAgedManVisitAnyT: Come visit me any- time you wish.
messages.CeruleanBadgeHouseBoulderBadgeText: The ATTACK of all POKEMON increases a little bit.It also lets you use FLASH any- time you desire.
messages.CeruleanBadgeHouseCascadeBadgeText: POKEMON up to L30 will obey you.Any higher, they become unruly!It also lets you use CUT outside of battle.
messages.CeruleanBadgeHouseThunderBadgeText: The SPEED of all POKEMON increases a little bit.It also lets you use FLY outside of battle.
messages.CeruleanBadgeHouseRainbowBadgeText: POKEMON up to L50 will obey you.Any higher, they become unruly!It also lets you use STRENGTH out- side of battle.
messages.CeruleanBadgeHouseSoulBadgeText: The DEFENSE of all POKEMON increases a little bit.It also lets you use SURF outside of battle.
messages.CeruleanBadgeHouseMarshBadgeText: POKEMON up to L70 will obey you.Any higher, they become unruly!
messages.CeruleanBadgeHouseVolcanoBadgeText: Your POKEMON's SPECIAL abilities increase a bit.
messages.BikeShopClerkWelcomeText: Hi! Welcome to our BIKE SHOP.Have we got just the BIKE for you!
messages.BikeShopClerkDoYouLikeItText: It's a cool BIKE! Do you want it?
messages.BikeShopClerkOhThatsAVoucherText: Oh, that's...A BIKE VOUCHER!OK! Here you go!
messages.BikeShopExchangedVoucherText: {PLAYER} exchanged the BIKE VOUCHER for a BICYCLE.
messages.BikeShopClerkHowDoYouLikeYourBicycleText: How do you like your new BICYCLE?You can take it on CYCLING ROAD and in caves!
messages.BikeShopBagFullText: You better make room for this!
messages.BikeShopMiddleAgedWomanText: A plain city BIKE is good enough for me!You can't put a shopping basket on an MTB!
messages.BikeShopYoungsterTheseBikesAreExpensiveT: These BIKEs are cool, but they're way expensive!
messages.BikeShopYoungsterCoolBikeText: Wow. Your BIKE is really cool!
